annotation.title_clean: Cyprus National AI Strategy 2032: A Strategic Blueprint
annotation.title_en: Cyprus National AI Strategy 2032: A Strategic Blueprint
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cyprus National AI Taskforce; Deputy Ministry of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy
annotation.venue: Deputy Ministry of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy, Republic of Cyprus
annotation.summary_en: Cyprus's national AI strategy to 2032 aims to make the country a trusted, EU-aligned AI hub. It sets eight objectives and eight priority sectors. It creates a National AI Authority, councils and committees, and requires risk-based controls with human oversight. Robotics appears only marginally, through an autonomous systems research focus area.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision: leading trusted AI hub in the Eastern Mediterranean by 2032, with full EU AI Act and GDPR alignment
Three-tier governance: National AI Authority, Interministerial AI Council, specialised committees
Every ministry deploying AI must maintain an Applied AI Strategy aligned with the EU AI Act, renewed every 3 years
Control framework: risk classification, approval gates, human oversight, incident reporting; ISO 42001 and ISO 27001 recommended
Targets: 15% productivity gain, about 3,000 AI professionals, sovereign compute, sandboxes and testbeds
